Multiply each term of the first bracket by each term of the second:
\(\left(3\sqrt{2}-\sqrt{3}\right)\left(4\sqrt{3}-\sqrt{2}\right) = 12\sqrt{6} - 3\times 2 - 4\times 3 + \sqrt{6}\)
\(= 12\sqrt{6} - 6 - 12 + \sqrt{6} = 13\sqrt{6} - 18\).
\(-18+13\sqrt{6}\)

The conjugate of \(\sqrt{7}+\sqrt{2}\) is \(\sqrt{7}-\sqrt{2}\). Multiply numerator and denominator by it:
\(\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{7}+\sqrt{2}} \times \dfrac{\sqrt{7}-\sqrt{2}}{\sqrt{7}-\sqrt{2}} = \dfrac{\sqrt{7}-\sqrt{2}}{\left(\sqrt{7}\right)^{2}-\left(\sqrt{2}\right)^{2}} = \dfrac{\sqrt{7}-\sqrt{2}}{7-2}\).
\(\dfrac{\sqrt{7}-\sqrt{2}}{5}\)

The conjugate of \(2\sqrt{5}-3\sqrt{2}\) is \(2\sqrt{5}+3\sqrt{2}\). Multiply numerator and denominator by it:
\(\dfrac{3}{2\sqrt{5}-3\sqrt{2}} \times \dfrac{2\sqrt{5}+3\sqrt{2}}{2\sqrt{5}+3\sqrt{2}} = \dfrac{3\left(2\sqrt{5}+3\sqrt{2}\right)}{\left(2\sqrt{5}\right)^{2}-\left(3\sqrt{2}\right)^{2}} = \dfrac{3\left(2\sqrt{5}+3\sqrt{2}\right)}{20-18}\).
\(\dfrac{3\left(2\sqrt{5}+3\sqrt{2}\right)}{2}\)

The conjugate of \(7+4\sqrt{3}\) is \(7-4\sqrt{3}\). Multiply numerator and denominator by it:
\(\dfrac{4}{7+4\sqrt{3}} \times \dfrac{7-4\sqrt{3}}{7-4\sqrt{3}} = \dfrac{4\left(7-4\sqrt{3}\right)}{7^{2}-\left(4\sqrt{3}\right)^{2}} = \dfrac{4\left(7-4\sqrt{3}\right)}{49-48} = \dfrac{4\left(7-4\sqrt{3}\right)}{1}\).
\(28-16\sqrt{3}\)

The conjugate of the denominator \(\sqrt{5}+\sqrt{3}\) is \(\sqrt{5}-\sqrt{3}\). Multiply numerator and denominator by it:
\(\dfrac{\sqrt{5}-\sqrt{3}}{\sqrt{5}+\sqrt{3}} \times \dfrac{\sqrt{5}-\sqrt{3}}{\sqrt{5}-\sqrt{3}} = \dfrac{\left(\sqrt{5}-\sqrt{3}\right)^{2}}{5-3} = \dfrac{5-2\sqrt{15}+3}{2} = \dfrac{8-2\sqrt{15}}{2}\).
\(4-\sqrt{15}\)
